## Description

One-way publish: each appointment of the doctor appears as "Busy · Medvya" with time only. No patient name, reason or location detail leaves Medvya. The doctor connects and disconnects from their account page.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** A published event contains no patient data (tested).
- [ ] **AC2.** Disconnecting deletes the published events and the stored tokens.
- [ ] **AC3.** Tokens are stored encrypted with Key Vault keys.

## Notes / open questions

- Pick up from DentalERP: the OAuth and event calls in the two service files. Remove anything that writes patient names into events.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
